Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role
Involvement at all stages of SDLC: analysis, design, development, unit and integration testing, UAT facilitation, packaging and deployment & operations
Collaborate with other developers, architects, business analysts, UX experts and business stakeholders to design and build a system that is efficient, effective, and scalable
Guide and mentor the junior developers towards the IT standards and best practices for SDLC
 Your profile
 Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed
University degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
At least 7 years of hands-on experience in software development with focus on .NET technologies, including architectural design and system integration
Expertise in modern web development framework, with knowledge in React
Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or GitLab CI, and proficiency in version control systems like Git and Bitbucket
Strong background with relational databases like MSSQL
Experience with cloud technologies and containerization/orchestration tools like Kubernetes or OpenShift
Fluency in English
